# fw-video crate

> Pure-Rust video conversion: MP4/H.264 decode (craft-libs), frame sampling, scene detection and colour vectorisation (visioncortex), exported as SVG, Markdown…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-video/

Pure-Rust video conversion: MP4/H.264 decode (craft-libs), frame sampling, scene detection and colour vectorisation (visioncortex), exported as SVG, Markdown, HTML, JSX and GPUI source.
